items.title: Akiyoshi Toshiko — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: And thanks to John Wilson, he wrote a really good review.

ctx.x: I needed about $3000 those days to—isn‟t that something? So cheap, you can‟t think of it today—the Town Hall concert. And that was a self-produced concert. Then it took me a year to prepare. And … then, uh, that time the mayor was [John] Lindsay, that was the mayor. And for some reason, he named that particular day [October 7, 1967] as the “Jazz Day” of New York. Now, that’s my luck! My God! You know, as I said, I prepared from a year before. And about a couple months before, whatever it is, and he said it it‟s…
Did you have good attendance, though?
